name: Neofetch System Info
description: Display Debian system summary, OS version, kernel, uptime, packages, and ASCII art logo
check_cmd: which neofetch >/dev/null 2>&1 || which fastfetch >/dev/null 2>&1 || test -f /usr/bin/neofetch || test -f /usr/bin/fastfetch
install_sudo: apt-get update && (apt-get install -y neofetch || apt-get install -y fastfetch)
